name: Madison County, NY
findings: Madison County has 244 nonprofit organizations. 117 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 102 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Madison County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Madison County list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 62 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 18 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.
